summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. filed a Form 6-K containing a Director/PDMR Shareholding notification. CFO Abhijit Bhattacharya acquired 20,000 ordinary shares at €12.48 per share on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural deal terms are noted. This is a routine disclosure of a PDMR transaction under market abuse regulations, not a special situation event. No further action or risk arbitrage angle applies.
